name: document-smart-reader
description: Token-efficient, page-aware local reading for PDF and DOCX files.

interface.shortDescription: Read long PDF and Word files with less context.
interface.longDescription: Builds a local page-aware Markdown cache, retrieves only relevant chunks, and routes layout-sensitive evidence to visual verification.
defaultPrompt: Read this PDF efficiently and cite the relevant pages.
Search this Word document without loading the whole file.
Summarize this document and verify layout-sensitive evidence.
